### Global Metadata
A complete 60-second tender, nostalgic memory piece for looking at old photographs of a small town's summers long ago, like a music box in an attic. 66 BPM, E major. A music-box celesta melody, soft felt piano, a warm string quartet, a single glockenspiel. Pure instrumental ensemble piece.

### Vocal Details
None. Instrumental only: the music box plays the melody, piano and strings accompany it.

### Timed Arrangement
0-12 seconds: music box alone. 12-36 seconds: piano and strings join, warm. 36-60 seconds: the melody once more, softly. Keep tempo, texture and loudness consistent from start to end; no big climax. The piece must play for the full 60 seconds and must not end early, ending cleanly on the tonic so it can loop.
